actual.response: The guest Wi‑Fi uses its own credentials. You can obtain the passphrase from reception or via the IT self‑service portal. Then select the guest SSID on your phone and enter the provided passphrase.

To resolve the VPN failure, try the following steps: 1) Restart the VPN client. 2) Verify your home internet connection is working. 3) Ensure the VPN client is up to date. 4) If it still fails, switch from Wi‑Fi to a wired connection. 5) Restart your home router.

To resolve the wired ‘no internet access’ issue, reseat the Ethernet cable at both ends, then release and renew the IP address. If the problem persists, try a different wall port or a different patch cable before escalating to a hardware check.

To set up eduroam on your phone, enter your username in the format username@institution.domain along with your standard password, then accept the certificate prompt when connecting for the first time.

It sounds like a DNS configuration problem. Try these steps: 1) Flush the local DNS cache on the laptop. 2) Verify that the DNS server settings are pointing to the correct internal resolver. 3) Restart the router or the network adapter to clear any transient DNS issues. These actions are recommended for cases where internal sites work but external sites do not.
Search the internal print server or self‑service portal for the printer by name or location and add it using the standard driver installer instead of a manual IP‑based setup.

To address the VPN failure from home, follow these steps: 1. Restart the VPN client. 2. Verify that your home internet connection is working properly. 3. Ensure the VPN client software is up to date. 4. If the issue persists, switch from Wi‑Fi to a wired Ethernet connection. 5. Restart your home router. These actions are based on the troubleshooting guidance for VPN connections from home.

To reset your password, go to the self‑service password reset portal and verify your identity using your registered email or authenticator app. Then choose a new password that meets the complexity requirements. If you are completely locked out, contact IT so they can verify your identity manually.
